sources.evidence_extract: DMP3036SFG (Diodes DS37038 Rev. 6-2, June 2023) 30 V P-channel MOSFET, PowerDI3333-8: top view pins 1-3 S, 4 G, 5-8 D, exposed pad D. Max ratings TA 25 C: VDSS -30 V; VGSS +/-25 V; ID at VGS -10 V -8.7 A (TA 25 C) / -7.0 A (TA 70 C) and at VGS -5 V -7.2 A / -5.8 A, both on 2 oz FR-4 with 1 in2 copper (Note 6); IS body diode -3.6 A. Thermal: RthJA 137 C/W minimum pad (Note 5), 55 C/W steady on 1 in2 copper (Note 6). EC 25 C: BVDSS -30 V min; VGS(th) -1.0/-2.0/-2.5 V; RDS(on) max 20 mOhm at VGS -10 V, ID -8 A and 29 mOhm at VGS -5 V, ID -5 A.
